messages:
emma: quick note: sampleapp onboarding keeps retrying when users submit bad metadata. backend returns 400 but SDK throws generic BadRequest, so client retry logic kicks in.

ryan: do we have the response body?

emma: example: { "error": { "kind": "parse_error", "message": "metadata must be an object" } } but older infra sometimes omits kind.

lu: proposal: SDKs should map error.kind -> typed errors (ParseError, ValidationError, AuthError, RateLimitError) and expose err.retriable (boolean), err.code (stable id), and err.help_url. fallback heuristics when kind missing (Retry-After for 429, regex for token/auth).

infra-bot: Created ticket DX-1310: standardize error payload and DX-1311: SDK error mapping.

dan: tests: unit tests for mapping + e2e where sampleapp sends malformed metadata to ensure no retries. also update CI fixtures.

emma: owner plan: ryan takes TS, lu takes Go, dan will update sampleapp. timeline: PRs this week. changelog note: "SDK: typed parse/validation errors, retriable flag, help_url."

ryan: i'll open TS PR by Thursday with migration notes.

lu: i'll mirror in Go and add a toLogEntry helper to include request_id/error_id.

dan: thanks team 0: should cut support tickets dramatically. :sparkles:
